name: Herodian
brief: A Jewish political party supporting the Herodian dynasty
short: The Herodians, mentioned in <ref="Matthew 22:16; Mrk.3.6; 12.13">Matthew 22:16; Mrk.3.6; 12.13</ref>, were a Jewish political party that supported the rule of the Herodian dynasty and collaborated with the Pharisees in their opposition to Jesus.
